post.originalText:
Gemini 4 Argon vs GPT-6 Astra, same one-shot prompt: a 3D lighthouse at dusk

Argon: 3 min. better mood, the beam actually sweeps
Astra on xhigh: 18 min. way more detail (stonework, railing, weathervane), but the beam is barely visible

speed or detail, which are you picking? https://t.co/KTdcledbe9
